card.title: PlayStation 5

claims.statement: PS5 (codename Erebus) parts: MN864739 HDMI encoder, CXD90061GG southbridge, CXD90062GG SSD controller, Dialog DA9081 SSD/NAND PMIC, Dialog DA9065 southbridge PMIC, 25Q16JVNIM BIOS IC, 0.1 µF X5R 0603 16 V cap behind the HDMI port.
Diode-mode reference images exist for EDM-020 USB, power/disc, M.2, LED, front USB, LAN, disc data and fan/drive power connectors, and for the HDMI port.

card.caveats: Reference diode readings are images, not transcribed. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
